content.title: Figure CEO on IPO: Blockchain lets you 'displace trust with truth'
content.description:
Stablecoin lender Figure Technology Solutions (FIGR) will make its public debut on the Nasdaq via an IPO on Thursday, raising $787.5 million from its IPO price of $25 per share.

Figure co-founder and executive chairman Mike Cagney sits down with Yahoo Finance executive editor Brian Sozzi to discuss the company's blockchain model for crypto transactions, the regulatory environment for stablecoins, and the executive's own background in personal finance technology.

Cagney is also the co-founder and former CEO of fintech company SoFi Technologies (SOFI).

Also catch Yahoo Finance's full interview with Klarna co-founder and CEO Sebastian Siemiatkowski after the buy now, pay later platform's public launch on Wednesday.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
